experiment: OTC-PTQ phase1 feasibility and consequence diagnostic
checkpoint_integrity: reuse prior compute-node verification; check identity metadata before loading
task_selection: first two suite tasks selected before OTC outcomes; fixed, no result-based selection
sites: 8 deterministic Linears, 4 video and 4 action across depth, exact registry recorded before scoring
reference_dtype: match pinned official smoke config; record actual runtime dtype, do not mislabel BF16 as FP16

quantizer.scope: one site across all denoising calls; all others reference precision

normalization: CAL-only pooled scalar executed-action population variance; mean per-pixel next-observation population std; epsilon_a=epsilon_o=0.001; lambda_a=lambda_o=1
success_scope: go/no-go for later joint-quantized closed-loop tests; no task-success gain, real-kernel speed or memory claim
parallel_policy: probe first; disjoint task/episode outputs only after replay verification, measured budget
